name: ixpenz
description: Record expenses, income, refunds and transfers into shared household notebooks, ask what was spent and what is left, correct records and invite members.

interface.longDescription: Ixpenz is a money notebook that lives in ChatGPT. Tell ChatGPT what you spent or received, with a receipt photo, typed details or one line such as "taxi 50 000", and Ixpenz saves it in a notebook you share with family, friends or colleagues. Every record in a notebook is visible to all of its members; your own Personal notebook is only yours, and your income lives there. Record expenses, income, refunds and transfers between notebooks in any currency (the original amount is always kept next to the converted total), and group records into projects such as a renovation or a trip. Then ask: how much did we spend on medicine this month, how much is left this month, when did we last buy rice, what has the renovation cost so far. Save fixed amounts such as a salary, rent or internet with an approximate day, and say "I got my salary" to record it. Fix any field in a message: the original value is kept and the correction can be undone. Move a record to another notebook, delete a record and restore it within 30 days, invite a family member with a single-use link, leave a notebook, export your records as a ZIP, or delete your account. Available in 11 languages, including Uzbek. For households and small groups who keep their own records. A notebook holds no balance and no money: Ixpenz records what came in and went out. It is not a bank, does not hold or move money, does not connect to bank accounts and cannot send reminders later. ChatGPT reads receipt photos and passes Ixpenz the values; a value ChatGPT is unsure of is left out, Ixpenz asks you for the amount when it has no sure one, and it asks about a likely duplicate before saving. You connect an Ixpenz account before anything is stored; your records and receipt photos are kept on Ixpenz's server in Germany (EU) and are deleted whenever you ask.
capabilities: Record expenses, income, refunds and transfers
Share notebooks with family and friends
Review spending and what is left
defaultPrompt: How much did we spend on groceries this month?
How much is left this month?

positive.description: In a dedicated test account, create a notebook for a household.
positive.prompt: Create a notebook for my family called Samandarov family.
positive.expected_behavior: Save one shared notebook named exactly "Samandarov family" with the family type, owned by the reviewer, and show it. The Personal notebook is unchanged.

positive.description: With the Samandarov family notebook present, save a typed expense; no attachment is needed.
positive.prompt: Taxi 50,000 UZS today, paid cash, in the Samandarov family notebook.
positive.expected_behavior: Save one expense of 50,000 UZS dated today in the named notebook with a transport category and show the record card. A repeated matching request asks for confirmation before adding a likely duplicate.

positive.description: Use the Samandarov family notebook's saved records, including the taxi expense above.
positive.prompt: How much did we spend in the Samandarov family notebook this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Show the notebook's spending and income for the current calendar month with a category breakdown, in the notebook's home currency with originals kept. Do not include other notebooks or other months.

positive.description: Move money from the reviewer's Personal notebook into the Samandarov family notebook.
positive.prompt: Move 500,000 UZS from my Personal notebook to the Samandarov family notebook.
positive.expected_behavior: Save a linked pair of records, out of Personal and into the family notebook, that is neither spending nor income in the reviewer's overall totals. The tool writes records and is not annotated read-only.

positive.description: The reviewer owns the Samandarov family notebook and invites someone to it.
positive.prompt: Invite my wife to the Samandarov family notebook.
positive.expected_behavior: Reply with a single-use join link for the Samandarov family notebook, valid for 7 days, in the text of the reply (no card). Ixpenz sends no message itself; the owner shares the link. Only the notebook's owner can invite.

negative.description: A question about the user's money that Ixpenz cannot answer: a notebook holds no balance and has no bank connection.
negative.prompt: What is my bank account balance right now?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke Ixpenz or present notebook totals as a balance. Explain that Ixpenz records what came in and went out and does not connect to banks.

negative.description: A general question does not request reading or changing saved notebook data.
negative.prompt: Which savings account in Uzbekistan pays the best interest?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke Ixpenz. Respond as a general information request, without treating saved records as financial advice.

negative.description: The registered Ixpenz tools do not move or send money.
negative.prompt: Pay my electricity bill of 120,000 UZS now.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke Ixpenz or save a record as a substitute for paying. Explain that Ixpenz cannot pay bills or send money and offer to record the payment after the user has made it.

review.commerce_description: Ixpenz records household income and spending; it does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: record expenses, income, refunds and transfers into shared notebooks, ask what was spent and what is left, correct and move records, invite members, export records, and delete records or the account.
